svg.title: EchoLoom — Product Features Teaser
svg.desc: Feature-led EchoLoom product teaser, reconstructed from the preceding feature-led image in this conversation. Headings, descriptions, cards and icons are editable vector elements. The two-phone illustration is one embedded raster image; the chat and story shown in it are illustrative mock-ups, not verified product screenshots. Product feature terminology is based on CSC454_A4_Saria&Roxy.pdf, pages 6–7 and 14. This teaser describes the product concept and MVP feature scope, not independently verified launch status. Canvas: 1920 × 1080 pixels. Fonts: EB Garamond and Inter with standard fallbacks. No fonts or external image dependencies are embedded.

path.aria-label: Create your story with companion AI
An AI companion story app that combines free conversation with shared story creation.
A STORY THAT GROWS WITH YOU.
Not just someone to chat with — a story world that grows with you.
For users who want character continuity, emotional connection, and story-driven interaction.
